boundary_evidence: The Nitro SDK's gx_g3x.c, 0x020553c0..0x02055998, less its first function: 13 functions from 0x02055454. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/GX_g3x.c, compiled with its own pinned mwccarm 1.2/sp2p3, emits 17: GXi_NopClearFifo128_ 0x94, G3X_SetHOffset 0x10, G3X_GetBoxTestResult 0x28, G3X_GetMtxStackLevelPJ 0x2c, G3X_GetMtxStackLevelPV 0x2c, G3X_InitTable 0xa8, G3X_SetClearColor 0x30, G3X_SetFogTable 0x14, G3X_SetEdgeColorTable 0x18, G3X_GetVectorMtx 0x48, G3X_GetClipMtx 0x48, G3X_SetFog 0x54, G3X_ResetMtxStack_2 0xac, G3X_InitMtxStack 0xb0, G3X_ClearFifo 0x34, G3X_ResetMtxStack 0x88, G3X_Init 0x15c. Thirteen land in that order: GXi_NopClearFifo128_, func_02055454, GetMtxStackLevelPJ, GetMtxStackLevelPV, InitTable (0xb8, drift), SetClearColor, SetFogTable, SetFog, ResetMtxStack, InitMtxStack, ClearFifo, Reset, func_0205583c, all at pret's sizes except InitTable. pret calls the 0x88 function G3X_ResetMtxStack and the 0xac one G3X_ResetMtxStack_2; ntrtwl/NitroSDK's gx_g3x.c names them G3X_Reset (the one that also resets PolygonAttr, TexImageParam and TexPlttBase after G3X_ResetMtxStack) and G3X_ResetMtxStack, and the members take the SDK names. GetBoxTestResult, SetEdgeColorTable, GetVectorMtx and GetClipMtx are absent because nothing in this game calls them.

func_020555a4 (0x18, between SetClearColor and SetFogTable) is G3X_SetToonTable: it copies 0x40 bytes to TOON_TABLE 0x4000380. pret's file doesn't have it (Pokemon doesn't link it), so its slot is the one place the order can't be checked against pret.

BOTTOM EDGE: GXi_NopClearFifo128_ (0x020553c0..0x02055454) is gx_g3x.c's first function by address, an asm function in pret too. It stays its own source (src/GXi_NopClearFifo128_.c) only because port/tools/hostgen.py skips any file holding an asm block, and the port hostgens this file for G3X::ClearFifo. Below it, func_020553a4 is the last of three 0x1c matrix-command wrappers that begin with Geometry_MatrixMultiply3x3 at 0x0205536c; none of them is in GX_g3x.c.
TOP EDGE: func_02055998 at 0x02055998 begins arm9/G3i (src/engine/gx/G3i.cpp).
No lifecycle or RTTI: G3X has no instance state and no virtuals.
notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from.

G3X_Init (func_0205583c), G3X_SetToonTable (func_020555a4) and G3X_SetHOffset (func_02055454) keep their linker names with C linkage, with their SDK names in source comments; the other members are G3X:: statics under the SDK names.

PC port: smoke_gx hostgens G3X::ClearFifo (_ZN3G3X9ClearFifoEv) by symbol, which emits this whole file; everything else is under #ifndef _MSC_VER because the rest calls SDK code the host build doesn't link. port/ntr/runtime.cpp supplies GXi_NopClearFifo128_.
